payload.title: Document newsletter inbox, processing and manual subscription management
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a publication user and operator, I want a guide to newsletter reading and intake status, so that I can manage subscriptions without confusing Monitor controls with sender actions.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Document newsletter inbox, processing and manual subscription management
  Scenario: Follow newsletter inbox guidance
    Given the provided-address feature and reader are documented with truthful implementation status
    When a user or operator follows the guide
    Then it explains original-message access, sender/date and derived-reference provenance
    And it explains processing state, failures, retry and privacy scope
    And it distinguishes deliberate confirmation or unsubscribe from automatic link scanning
    And it states that pausing monitoring is not unsubscribing
    And full compose or reply behavior is not implied
```

Verify later against the actual inbox UI and scanner behavior. Document mailbox/address ownership, read permissions, retention, action-link privacy, attachments/remote content and error recovery. This is email milestone documentation; it must not wait on the Markus initiative or outbound feed documentation.
